reviewItem.question: Does "Potentially BREAKING: The CA and SelfSigned issuers now use SHA-512 when signing with RSA keys 4096 bits and above, and SHA-384 when signing with RSA keys 3072…" mean a change to protocol-behavior:cert-manager|name=ca-selfsigned-rsa-signing-hash (behavior-changed)?

proposed.statement: CA and SelfSigned issuers now sign with SHA-512 for RSA keys of 4096 bits and above and SHA-384 for RSA keys of 3072 bits and above, so systems must support these hash algorithms.
